source.upstream: references/styles/01_通用母版/几何装饰/便当格卡片风.md

visual_language.direction: bento grid modular card deck, light gray or cream canvas with rounded unequal-height cards in a CSS-grid lattice, 1px hairline borders and soft micro-shadows, giant KPI numerals with tabular figures, inline SVG sparklines and line icons, breathing whitespace between modules

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以不等高圆角卡片网格、微描边呼吸感与每卡一洞见的便当格纪律,做产品功能汇总与 QBR 指标汇报;2×2/3 列卡片每卡一个数字、线性图标或 sparkline
legacy_payload.visual_direction: bento grid modular card deck, light gray or cream canvas with rounded unequal-height cards in a CSS-grid lattice, 1px hairline borders and soft micro-shadows, giant KPI numerals with tabular figures, inline SVG sparklines and line icons, breathing whitespace between modules

canvas.background: 浅灰/奶白底 #F5F5F7(近黑底暗场变体允许,行为不变)
canvas.composition: grid-template-areas 式不等高卡片网格:每卡一洞见(数字/线性 icon/sparkline),卡片浅色分区底
canvas.density: medium-high,密而不挤——卡间距呼吸感是生命线

color_palette.accent: #0071E3(品牌主色点睛,示例 Apple 蓝;每 deck 换品牌色)
color_palette.rule: 底 + 卡两层中性,品牌主色只进关键数字/图标/高亮条;1-2 强调色封顶;卡片圆角 + 1px 发丝描边 + 微阴影,禁重边框

typography.title: 超大 display 标题(Inter / 思源黑体 Heavy)+ 常规正文的强字重对比
typography.body: 同族常规字重,卡片内短句
typography.labels: KPI 数字 tabular figures(Geist Mono / JetBrains Mono 气质)

layout_patterns: 标题页 = 巨型单句 + 大留白(不进便当格)
便当页 = 2×2 / 3 列不等高卡片矩阵,每卡一个洞见:KPI 大数字 / 线性 icon / sparkline 内联 SVG
one-insight 页 = 单个超大数字占卡 2/3 + 一行注,独占一页
暗场变体 = 近黑底 + 同构卡片(描边替阴影),行为纪律不变
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 每卡一洞见不贪多:数字/图标/火花线三选一为主;卡片不等高才有便当感,禁均分九宫格
negative_prompt: no uniform equal-height tile grid — bento cards vary in span and height
no heavy borders or drop shadows; 1px hairline and micro-shadow only
no rainbow card fills; cards stay neutral, brand color points the insight
no clip-art icons; inline stroke line icons only

visual_elements.allowed: 圆角卡片,1px 发丝描边,微阴影,KPI 巨数字,sparkline,线性 icon,呼吸留白
visual_elements.avoid: 均分格子;重边框;彩虹卡底;位图图标;贴图素材

rendering_constraints: Unequal-height card lattice (grid-template-areas feel); zero pasted images.
KPI numerals in tabular figures; sparklines as inline SVG strokes.
legacy_payload.reference: GitHub: huashu-design · design-styles.md PPT 库「Bento便当格模块网格」

recommendation_features.feature_defaults_basis: family-prior (U3)：机械默认按家族语义先验替换，来源记录在案

negative: Unequal-height card lattice (grid-template-areas feel); zero pasted images.
KPI numerals in tabular figures; sparklines as inline SVG strokes.
